profile_text.body:
Seagate Technology Holdings plc is a public company, traded under the ticker STX and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001137789, headquartered in Singapore. On its own site the company describes itself as a leader in mass-capacity data storage and says it has delivered more than four billion terabytes of capacity over the past four decades. It says it makes storage that scales and that it aims to bring trust and integrity to innovations that depend on data.

The site frames AI as the main force behind current storage demand. Seagate says AI is accelerating data growth and reshaping storage requirements, that people and machines will create in more ways at a faster pace as AI proliferates, and that it is optimizing storage for AI with gains in capacity meant to support efficient data center architecture and buildout. It also invites organizations to evaluate their readiness and develop a storage strategy built for performance, scale, and growth.

The record holds no litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers for the company.
